description: In the natural numbers with a new top point, its predecessors are exactly the naturals, it is a greatest limit point, each n+1 immediately follows n, and the order is not isomorphic to the usual natural-number order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.top_order_structure :
  (Set.Iio ⊤ = Set.range fun n => ↑n) ∧
    Order.IsSuccLimit ⊤ ∧ IsMax ⊤ ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), ↑n ⋖ ↑(n + 1)) ∧ ¬Nonempty (WithTop ℕ ≃o ℕ)
